id: title:Gilbert09:accept a scoped api key that lacks one read permission

observations.behavior: Adds a helper `_is_missing_permission` and its use to distinguish ElevenLabs-specific missing-scope responses. The probe no longer relies on the removed `validate_via_probe`; it now checks both 403 and 401 carrying this marker.
observations.posthog_connection: This could help warehouse ingestion avoid false negatives when an API key lacks required scopes but remains otherwise valid; users would not be blocked at connection time for recoverable permission issues.

observations.behavior: Changes credential validation behavior: previously only 403 was treated as missing scope; now also treats certain 401s with the specific body marker as missing permissions rather than invalid keys.
observations.posthog_connection: Could reduce unnecessary account-setup failures during warehouse source provisioning by correctly distinguishing transient permission gaps from bad credentials.

observations.behavior: Adds test cases asserting that 401 responses with the "missing_permissions" body are accepted at create-time while still rejecting them at schema-level probing.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection against misclassifying a recoverable permission issue as an invalid key in warehouse connector setup. No adoption or benefit is demonstrated here.

observations.limitations: Only one connector implementation is shown; broader compatibility and production behavior remain unverified. The change does not demonstrate recovery handling, retry behavior, or end-to-end ingestion correctness.

review.limitations: Only one connector implementation is shown; broader compatibility and production behavior remain unverified. The change does not demonstrate recovery handling, retry behavior, or end-to-end ingestion correctness.
review.reason: The patch demonstrates a bounded improvement to credential-probe classification for ElevenLabs, including removal of a shared helper, addition of targeted checks, and corresponding tests. This could help reliability and user experience but lacks evidence of systemic risk reduction across components.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to warehouse-source provisioning and connection diagnostics; may prevent false negatives when users have valid API keys missing certain scopes.
review.uncertainty: This assessment relies solely on this chunk; other hunks and integration behavior are unknown. No tier-3 systemic benefits can be established without wider context.
